title: Enterprise Connectivity: connectivity meter pricing
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs connectivity meter pricing for service charge, ancillary meter, nonfinancial service record.

## Policy clause 1
The selected contract provides committed line capacity line capacity; exceeding it requires a signed capacity amendment, while data transfer billing remains based on actual measured GB.

## Policy clause 2
Primary meter internet outbound transfer uses standard unit price after monthly included outbound transfer for the same holding and calendar month. provisioned port hours use port-hour price; cross-zone transfer, cross-region transfer, private interconnect outbound transfer and ingress use same-region cross-zone price, cross-region transfer price, private interconnect outbound price and inbound transfer price respectively.

## Policy clause 3
A transfer has exactly one destination class, so those destination rates never add together. NAT processed GB uses NAT processing price and NAT provisioned hours uses NAT provisioning price as distinct processing and provisioning components. allocated IPv4 address-hours uses allocated IPv4 address-hour price per allocated address-hour, including unused allocated addresses. new physical connection uses physical connection provisioning fee per completed new physical connection; a reprovisioned existing connection is not a new setup. loadbalancer uses load-balancer capacity-hour price per capacity-unit-hour.

## Policy clause 4
No Network transfer is invoiced if its export assigns billing ownership to another product; the assigned product exclusively invoices it.

## Policy clause 5
Free ingress stays visible in the meter history without a financial charge.

## Policy clause 6
For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal places and rounding convention and tax under tax treatment rules.

## Superseded scope 7
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval beginning then source-event reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

## Policy clause 8
Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

## Policy clause 9
Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices.

## Policy clause 10
These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

## Policy clause 11
For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

## Policy clause 12
Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic generic monthly included volume where expressly named; they are not added twice.

## Policy clause 13
A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Points of judgement
A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the committed line capacity, port-hour price, monthly included outbound transfer, same-region cross-zone price, cross-region transfer price, private interconnect outbound price, inbound transfer price, NAT processing price, NAT provisioning price, allocated IPv4 address-hour price, physical connection provisioning fee, load-balancer capacity-hour price, monetary decimal places, rounding convention, standard unit price used by this rule.

## Record identity: ancillary meter
A measured ancillary service occurrence is recorded in its own physical unit. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, interval beginning, interval ending.

## Record identity: nonfinancial service record
The support desk records delivered reviews, response measurements, contact assignments or other nonfinancial entitlements. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification.
